ValidationRule.description: Un Product Specialist no puede tener PS Product Family y PS Product vacío
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( ISPICKVAL(DES_Member_Role__c, 'Product Specialist'), OR ( ISBLANK(TEXT(DES_PS_Product_Family__c)), ISBLANK(DES_PS_Product__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Product Specialist must have Product Family and Product associated.
